statuses.name: Cozy
statuses.description: Reduce direct damage by 10% per stack. Does not reduce scald.

statuses.name: Scald
statuses.description: Lose 12 HP per stack at round end, bypassing shields. Steep removes one stack when healing.

statuses.name: Tangle
statuses.description: Direct hits add 1 break pressure per stack. Takes effect immediately.

statuses.name: Steep
statuses.description: Heal 18 HP per stack at round end and remove one Scald stack.

statuses.name: Crumb trail
statuses.description: Stores 24 damage per stack for a detonation. Detonation consumes all stacks.

statuses.name: Scented
statuses.description: Can be targeted through front-row protection and takes 20% more direct damage.

statuses.name: Rattled
statuses.description: Direct damage dealt falls by 15% per stack.

statuses.name: Drowsy
statuses.description: Committed enemy signature becomes a half-power basic. Every actor still takes its turn.

statuses.name: Glaze
statuses.description: Gain 20 shield per stack when starting a turn, capped at 60% maximum HP.

statuses.name: Shelter
statuses.description: Hostile single-target intents prefer this actor while alive. Row-wide attacks remain row-wide.

statuses.name: Saucer riposte
statuses.description: Each direct hostile hit returns 16 damage per stack. Reflections cannot trigger reflections.

statuses.name: Hush
statuses.description: Enemy heal, summon or shield action becomes a basic. Cat energy skills cost 1 more.

statuses.name: Brittle sugar
statuses.description: Each direct hit removes an extra 15 shield per stack before damage.

statuses.name: Apron link
statuses.description: The living source takes 30% of direct HP damage to the linked ally. Shared damage does not chain.

statuses.name: Second sprout
statuses.description: Consume to survive a fatal hit at 25% HP, once per battle per actor.

statuses.name: Yarn decoy
statuses.description: Absorbs the next direct hit entirely, then disappears. Scald passes through.
